mapper.delete: delete from u_patrol_task a, u_patrol_task_attr b where a.task_id = b.task_id and a.create_time < #{expireDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
delete from u_patrol_result a, u_patrol_data_result b where a.task_id = b.task_id and a.create_time < #{expireDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
delete from sys_logs a where a.create_time < #{expireDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
